name: hivemind-context
description: Consult, verify, and contest HiveMind decisions from Codex by description, never by id, through the deterministic local CLI.

interface.shortDescription: Consult past decisions before you change something.
interface.longDescription: Installs the hivemind-context skill and CLI-only command scripts. The skill teaches Codex when to check HiveMind for standing decisions before touching a module, verify whether an old decision still holds, and push back (disagree) or move on (supersede) by description — never by guessing an id.
defaultPrompt: What should I know before I touch this file?
What did we decide about X?
